title: answer
description: The answer to one decision or query, from the user, the docs or the policy.

decision.description: The id of the decision or query: the thread of the answer.

question.description: The question of the decision, for the render.

source.description: For a docs answer: the file and the section.

reason.description: Why a default or a docs answer applies.

onDefault.description: For a policy answer: what the session must do with the default.
